body.name: observable-margin dual and Pareto order
body.construction: Set \(\mathcal D_{\mathcal J}(q):=\{\mu\ge0:\sum_\theta\mu_\theta m_S(\theta)=\sum_\theta q_\theta m_S(\theta)\ \forall S\in\mathcal J\}\). Call \(b\in\mathcal C_{\mathcal J}(f)\) Pareto-admissible when no \(b'\in\mathcal C_{\mathcal J}(f)\) satisfies \(b'\le b\) pointwise with a strict inequality somewhere.
